create_ADE20K_dataset_train: create an ADE20K dataset instance using the train split with a specified root directory
create_ADE20K_dataset_val: create an ADE20K dataset instance using the val split for validation purposes
get_image_data_by_index: get raw image bytes from the ADE20K dataset by providing an integer index
get_target_segmentation_by_index: get raw segmentation target data from the ADE20K dataset by providing an integer index
load_ADE20K_file_paths: load image and segmentation file paths from ADE20K split text files using _load_file_paths
